notes: The clamped balance is the largest suffix total, floored at 0: the adder idiom (x add closures, fold body map 0 cons) gives every suffix total plus the empty suffix's 0, then the maximum by folding filter over (v-1 swap lt?) tests. 39 ops; empty input gives 0.

notes: Filter the whole list by each 'at least x_k' test in turn, keeping every stage: stage k holds the values not below the prefix maximum, and its head is the first occurrence of that maximum. Step closures (uncons dup F filter [cons] dip) are built by five short maps and run by a 2-atom fold body, then the stages are put in order, the unfiltered list dropped, and the heads taken. 74 ops; empty input works.

notes: The sides as a list, the perimeter p as a one-item list, one 'more than 2x' test per side, fold filter over the tests from (p), and sum the survivors (p or 0). a+b>c is p>2c, so this is exact for any signs. 39 ops, no ifte.

notes: Same reverse and slot-swap deal as pair_sums, but the steps are (x cons quote cat) run over the other pile as singletons, which rebuilds the pairs in order; each pair gets a leading 0 so the 3-atom test (i add lt?) reads 0 < a+b, the positive pairs are kept, and one fold drops the 0s and flattens. 84 ops; empty input works.
